_note: c2-duplication-detection's capture band — a 20-35% indicative range on confirmed duplicated cost. This is never the whole duplicated cost: some of every parallel build-out is genuine local variation, and claiming the full figure as recoverable is the most common way a consolidation business case overstates itself.
minInstanceHeadcountNote: Below this, an instance is a stray hire at a satellite site, not a parallel build-out worth pricing as duplication.
eligibleArchetypesNote: Only transactional-archetype functions are scanned for duplication. Site-operational work is expected to be distributed (excluded by design, same as clinical presence). Advisory work's own recommended pattern is hub-and-spoke — a deliberate centre-plus-local-partner split, not the accidental parallel build-out this skill prices.
